subject: Re: Pricing
text:
Hi Will,

Since there are some variability on how companies define VPC and on prem, we want to take a more granular approach in showing what we need.

Yang wrote down the two integration options that could meet our requirement. We need deployment by EOY. Can you please review and provide feasibility and updated pricing proposal for both by Monday EOD?  Thanks!

Option One:  The third-party annotation platform vendor will provide their containerized solution (e.g. consisting of frontend and backend containers) for deployment on our EC2 instances. Once deployed, we can explore two integration options with our existing data infrastructure: either through API integration (preferred option) , where the third-party platform can directly access our data infrastructure APIs to retrieve annotation dataset IDs and pre-signed URLs for video data access, or through manual integration by exchanging JSON files for job creation and other workflows. The specific details regarding permission groups and technical implementation can be discussed further once we confirm this as our preferred approach. The diagram below illustrates the high-level integration workflow.

[3P_Annotation_Architecture.png]

Option Two:  If the third-party annotation platform requires additional AWS services beyond EC2 deployment and cannot be containerized effectively, we propose creating a dedicated AWS account for the vendor's deployment needs. Amazon will maintain ownership of this AWS account while granting the vendor necessary permissions to deploy and manage their services within it.

[Deployment in Ring Owned AWS account.png]

subject: Re: FiDi Large Party Platter order
text:
Hi. Thanks for reaching out to Schlok's - FiDi.

*Issue with a DoorDash or UberEats order?* Please reach out to their support directly via their app. 

*Issue with a Schlok's app or website order?* Use the "Chat with Support" feature under Settings.  

*Issue with a catering or walk-up order?* If it's urgent, please text us at 415-971-7235 for the fastest response. Otherwise, a manager will respond via email by the end of the day. 

Please note that we do not accept orders via email or phone. More info about our business is below: 

We are open every day from 7:30am to 3pm, or until sold out, which does sometimes happen before 3pm. Our Instagram stories @schloksbagels is updated every day if we sell out. 

Pre-ordering goes live at 2pm for next-day orders. The rest of our bagels are available for walk-up and delivery orders (individual coffee is only available via walk-up ordering at this time on weekends, but bulk is available for pre-order). 

If you’re interested in a catering/larger group order, check out the Catering page on our website at www.schloks.com for our catering menu (please note, catering orders require at least 48 hours' notice). 

For all other inquiries, a manager will respond during our normal hours of operation.

Thanks for the support!
